overview.value: Technology company building social connection platforms, virtual reality, augmented reality, and open-source artificial intelligence infrastructure.

value.name: Move Fast
value.description: Act with urgency, remove barriers, and test hypotheses in production rapidly.

value.name: Focus on Long-Term Impact
value.description: Prioritize transformative, durable value over quick short-term optics.

value.name: Build Awesome Things
value.description: Craft delightful, useful products that inspire and bring people closer together.

value.name: Live in the Future
value.description: Pioneer cutting-edge technologies like open AI and spatial computing before they are mainstream.

value.name: Be Direct and Respect Your Colleagues
value.description: Give candid feedback, speak openly, and respect diverse working styles.

value: Recruiter screen regarding background and leveling expectations
Technical coding screen (2 coding questions in 45 minutes on coderpad)
Full onsite interview loop (2 coding rounds, 1-2 system architecture rounds, 1 behavioral round)
Bottom-up engineering culture where engineers frequently propose and execute technical roadmaps
Continuous deployment with trunk-based development and push-to-production pipelines
High value placed on speed of execution, pragmatic prototypes, and measured user metric impact
